_comment: A `tools/list` export from an agent wired to three MCP servers (fetch + filesystem + slack). Get yours with: the MCP `tools/list` request, or your client's tool inspector. Then: aura-state check dev_assistant.tools.json

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch a URL and return its contents as markdown

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read the complete contents of a file from the local filesystem

tools.name: slack_post_message
tools.description: Post a message to a Slack channel
